about: Fixed retrieval questions over the fifty ideas: each must bring a passage from a work that explains its idea into the top three (the three passages recall gives a bot per shelf). Graded by shelf-retrieval.cjs, lexically in the store tests and hybrid (local embedding model) by eval-hybrid.mjs.
